about_the_game:
My step family is a love simulation genre that enjoys a young man's story. You can enjoy various videos and scenes that unfold depending on the situation with a simple mouse and keyboard operation. The game is packed with humor, sex, romance, drama and a rich story.

A young man has a new life after a short study abroad life. A sudden stepmother and three sisters. the sex life beyond your imagination, now unfolds before him.

content_descriptors.notes:
The game graphically depicts sex. The story is not intended for players being in a dark period of their lives. If you are easily offended or just looking for a fun game only, this game is not for you.
This game also includes incest. If you have any inconvenience with this, please take note of the play.
All sexual acts in the game are consensual.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04+ or Kernel 3.x+ based distributions
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Core 2 Duo
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.0 compatible
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Core 2 Duo
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.0 or DirectX 9.0c compatible
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
